title: WeMacro Bluetooth valid zero batch count underflows the encoded count
description:
COUNT advertises a minimum0 but the accepted batch encodes (uint32_t)count-1, turning0 into UINT32_MAX. This contradicts the bounded step-count contract and portable sibling minimum1. Set a correct minimum or define safe zero semantics before transmission and test zero/minimum/maximum encoding. Device execution was not measured. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
